subject: english
title: Talking About People
summary: Learning to describe people, their professions, and daily activities in English

sections.title: Meeting People
sections.content: In this section, students learn how to greet people and introduce themselves. Common greetings include 'Good morning', 'Good afternoon', and 'Hello'. Students practice asking questions like 'What is your name?', 'Where are you from?', and 'What do you do?'

sections.title: Describing People
sections.content: Students learn to describe people using adjectives. Examples: 'He is tall and friendly', 'She has long black hair', 'They are hardworking'. Vocabulary includes words for physical appearance (tall, short, young, old) and personality (kind, helpful, honest, cheerful).

sections.title: Talking About Professions
sections.content: Different professions are introduced: teacher, doctor, engineer, farmer, fisherman, rickshaw puller, shopkeeper. Students practice sentences like 'My father is a farmer', 'She wants to be a doctor', 'They work in a hospital'. The importance of all professions is discussed.

sections.title: Grammar: Present Simple
sections.content: The present simple tense is used to talk about habits, routines, and facts. Structure: Subject + verb (add 's' for he/she/it). Examples: 'I get up at 6 am', 'She reads books every day', 'The sun rises in the east'. Negative: 'do/does not'. Questions: 'Do/Does + subject?'
